Attached: 1 image

hora is ready for iPhone Duo.

Folded, it's just hora. Unfolded, it's a layout we built only for the inner display: the whole week, the mini calendar and all your calendars on one screen.

Best part: Focus Time Scheduler and Pomodoro came out of the tabs. Same features, but people actually use them when they can see them.

Aiming to be available on 23rd of October. 🤞🏻
